prompt:
One completely new game furniture sprite atlas for an old persimmon-tree courtyard home in rural Sichuan, China. 1536x1024 landscape, 8 isolated sprites in 2 rows x 4 columns. Real transparent PNG alpha=0 in all empty space, furniture opaque. No background, no floor, no grid lines, no text, no people. Modest practical old village household.
Top row left to right: 1 a heavy square eight-immortals dining table made of dark chestnut wood, thick straight legs, a little bowl with TWO orange persimmons and plain tea cup; 2 two low solid plank stools sitting together as one seating sprite, weathered honey-brown wood, no backrests; 3 a traditional dark wooden canopy-free low bed with chunky square posts, rust-orange folded cotton quilt with a cream stripe and one worn pillow; 4 a wide low grain storage cabinet with three hinged bin doors, old wooden scoop and a folded grain sack, squat rather than tall.
Bottom row left to right: 5 broad gray brick wood-burning countryside stove, two round iron cooking openings, stacked firewood and clay water jar beside it; 6 simple broad dark wood reclining daybed with woven reed mat and a cylindrical brown pillow, no upholstered sofa arms; 7 a persimmon drying rack with a flat bamboo tray of orange fruit above two shelves of empty wicker baskets, practical lightweight wooden frame, entirely different shape from a dining table; 8 a squat old oil lamp with a clear glass chimney and dark green metal base, no large glow.
Coherent palette: persimmon orange, dark chestnut brown, weathered wheat gold, stone gray, tiny moss green. Give every item an original recognizable construction; no grape motifs, no rattan sofa, no modern drawers.
Same front-facing top-down oblique orthographic RPG view, top surfaces seen around 35 degrees, vertical sides vertical, no diagonal isometric arrangement.
VERY CHUNKY AUTHENTIC PIXEL ART, whole sheet looks originally hand-placed on a 256x170 pixel grid then enlarged 6x nearest-neighbor. Every sprite about 45-65 logical pixels across. Large clear square pixel blocks, sharp dark stepped outlines, only 2-3 flat shades on a material. No painterly wood grain, no fine noise, no smooth shading, no antialiasing, no blur, no pixelation filter effect. Bright readable silhouette and simple restrained detail. Keep complete objects separate with transparent gutters.
